entry.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
entry.summary: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.

entry.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
entry.summary: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

entry.title: From professor to patient: One man's journey on the frontier of lung cancer treatment
entry.summary: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer, but new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients.

entry.title: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
entry.summary: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

entry.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entry.summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entry.title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?
entry.summary: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs. Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.

entry.title: There's a global pandemic treaty that's signed -- and in 'limbo.' What's the holdup?
entry.summary: The treaty aims to help the countries of the world prepare for — and defeat — any future pandemic. Why hasn't it gone into effect?

entry.title: Mom! Mom! MOM! 3 ways to stay calm in stressful parenting moments
entry.summary: Parenthood can be overwhelming. A therapist and mom of three shares techniques to help calibrate your emotions — so you can show up better for yourself and your family.

entry.title: Congress passed $100 million for teen pregnancy prevention. Most of it is untouched
entry.summary: With days left to go in the 2026 fiscal year, lawmakers push the health department to spend the money Congress allocated to prevent teen pregnancy. An NPR exclusive.

entry.title: President Trump's FDA commissioner nom, Dr. Heidi Overton, faces Senators' questions
entry.summary: Dr. Heidi Overton has been nominated to be the new FDA commissioner. The Senate HELP committee pressed her on vaccines, mifepristone, food safety and whether she can tell the president he's wrong.
